instruction: Change the system timezone to UTC-6 (Central Standard Time).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting timezone to UTC-6 (CST/US Central). Evaluator checks if timedatectl output shows timezone offset as -0600.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluator logic: checks if timedatectl output line ends with '-0600)'
